name: asyncAllOf
description: Returns a Future that completes once every Future in the array has completed, or fails as soon as any of them fails. The combined Future only signals completion: calling `get()` on it returns null, so read each result from the original Futures. An empty array returns a Future that is already complete.

params.name: futures
params.description: An array of Future objects, such as those returned by `runAsync()`.

examples.title: Wait for several Futures
examples.description: Waits for both tasks, then reads each result from its own Future.
